source: It's not your fault, Aiden... I was being insensitive to your feelings, after all...
translation: 这不是你的错，Aiden……毕竟，是我没有体谅你的感受……

source: If I had only told you sooner that I wasn't gonna accept the offer, we wouldn't have argued...
translation: 如果我早点告诉你我不会接受那份邀请，我们就不会吵架了……

source: Even though I felt strongly about my choice, I couldn’t admit to you that I was letting it go like that.
translation: 尽管我非常坚持自己的选择，却没法承认自己就这样放弃了这个机会。

source: Especially after seeing how excited you were for me. I didn’t want to let you down…
translation: 尤其是看到你为我感到那么高兴之后。我不想让你失望……

source: But still, I was blinded by the opportunity, thinking it was best for you, regardless of the cost.
translation: 但即便如此，我还是被这个机会蒙蔽了双眼，觉得不管代价是什么，它都是对你最好的选择。

source: Now I realize that I wasn't even considering the reason you had for making that decision...
translation: 现在我才意识到，我甚至没有考虑过你做出那个决定的理由……

source: I know this is going to sound unreasonable, but…
translation: 我知道这听起来很不合理，可是……

source: As soon as I heard I’d be separated from you again, it just wasn’t worth it anymore.
translation: 一听说我又要和你分开，我就觉得那份机会不值得了。

source: I… don’t want to be alone again…
translation: 我……不想再孤单了……

source: I understand, Aiden… I was stupid to not have realized that…
translation: 我明白，Aiden……是我太傻了，竟然没意识到这一点……

source: When we got separated, I lost touch with you completely…
translation: 我们分开后，我彻底和你失去了联系……

source: I went out there and got all sorts of jobs to make enough money for the both of us, and to afford Dad’s medication.
translation: 我出去做了各种工作，努力赚够我们两人的生活费和爸爸的药费。

source: Hey, Dad! Sorry, I had to work overtime again…! And I got stuck in a traffic jam too!
translation: 嘿，爸爸！抱歉，我又加班了……！而且还遇上了堵车！

source: Ah, welcome back, son…
translation: 啊，欢迎回来，儿子……

source: Sheesh… I feel bad, it’s almost midnight and you haven’t eaten yet…
translation: 天啊……都快半夜了，你还没吃东西，我真过意不去……

source: Anyway, lemme just heat this up so you can take your meds and—
translation: 总之，我先把这个热一下，这样你就能吃药，然后——

source: Aiden, wait…
translation: Aiden，等等……

source: What’s the matter, Dad? Not feeling great tonight?
translation: 怎么了，爸爸？今晚感觉不太舒服吗？

source: N-No, it’s not that…
translation: 不、不是那样……

source: It’s just… I’ve been thinking…
translation: 只是……我一直在想……

source: About what…?
translation: 想什么……？

source: It’s been over five years… and I’m only getting worse…
translation: 已经五年多了……而我的病情却越来越糟……

source: Y-You’ll get better, Dad! If we just keep doing the treatments, there’s a chance you’ll recover…!
translation: 你、你会好起来的，爸爸！只要我们继续治疗，你就有机会康复……！

source: Aiden… The doctors have already told us there’s no cure, and I’ll always have to be hooked up like this…
translation: Aiden……医生已经告诉过我们，这病没有治愈的办法，我以后也只能一直这样靠着仪器维持……

source: Wh-What are you trying to say, Dad…?
translation: 你、你到底想说什么，爸爸……？

source: Even though the pain’s been around for so long, it just… hurts.
translation: 即使疼痛已经伴随我这么久，它还是……很痛。

source: It hurts to see you wasting your life on me like this with every passing day…
translation: 看着你日复一日这样把人生耗在我身上，我很痛苦……

source: You still have a future ahead of you, and I’m near the end of the road…
translation: 你的人生还很长，而我已经走到尽头了……

source: Don’t say that, Dad! I’m your son, and I’m gonna take care of you no matter what…!!
translation: 别这么说，爸爸！我是你的儿子，无论如何我都会照顾你……！！

source: I know that, Aiden… but…
translation: 我知道，Aiden……但是……

source: I’m your father and I’m the one you’re supposed to rely on…
translation: 我是你的父亲，本该是你依靠的人……

source: Instead, I’m burdening you like this… because I couldn’t take care of my own health…
translation: 可我反而这样拖累着你……因为我没能照顾好自己的健康……

source: Wh-What? Th-That’s not true, Dad!
translation: 什、什么？这、这不是真的，爸爸！

source: You wouldn’t have gotten sick if you didn’t work so hard to take care of me!
translation: 如果不是为了照顾我，你也不会因为工作那么辛苦而生病！

source: But even with all that… I was never able to give you the life you deserved.
translation: 可即使这样……我还是没能给你本应拥有的人生。

source: All we were doing was just surviving before we found Camp Buddy.
translation: 在找到 Camp Buddy 之前，我们一直只是在勉强活着。

source: It was there that I saw you begin to have friends… dreams… and hope for the future…
translation: 在那里，我看着你开始拥有朋友……梦想……以及对未来的希望……

source: And yet, I dragged you away from it… because I didn’t want us to be so helpless, always relying on others…
translation: 然而，我却把你从那里带走了……因为我不想让我们变得如此无助，永远依赖别人……

source: I really thought I could make it work, and give that kind of life to you myself, but here I am…
translation: 我真的以为自己可以做到，亲手给你那样的生活，可现在的我却变成了这样……

source: It was selfish… and I truly regret it…
translation: 那太自私了……我真的很后悔……

source: I-I’m so sorry, Aiden… My son…
translation: 对、对不起，Aiden……我的儿子……

source: Dad… It’s not your fault…
translation: 爸爸……这不是你的错……

source: And I’m still here…
translation: 而且我还在这里……

source: So, p-please… Don’t give up…
translation: 所、所以请你……不要放弃……

source: I’m not giving up, Aiden…
translation: 我没有放弃，Aiden……

source: But I need you to understand…
translation: 但我需要你明白……

source: …That I have to let go.
translation: ……我必须放手了。

source: I want you to have your own life…
translation: 我希望你能拥有属于自己的生活……

source: To do the things you like…  be with people you love… and find what truly makes you happy…
translation: 去做你喜欢的事……和你爱的人在一起……找到真正让你快乐的东西……

source: I’ll always be your father, and you’ll always be my son… So don’t be afraid…
translation: 我永远都是你的父亲，而你永远都是我的儿子……所以，不要害怕……

source: D-Dad… No… Please… Stop….
translation: 爸、爸爸……不……求你了……别说了……

source: I-I’m very… very tired, Aiden…
translation: 我、我很……很累了，Aiden……

source: Despite all of my shortcomings and the mistakes I’ve made… you were the best thing that ever happened to me…
translation: 尽管我有许多不足，也犯过很多错误……你仍然是我人生中发生过的最美好的事……

source: So please… grant me this last wish…
translation: 所以请你……答应我最后一个愿望……

source: Let’s go home…
translation: 我们回家吧……

source: We’ll cook our favorite dish… Eat together like a family… Like we used to, Aiden…
translation: 我们做最喜欢的菜……像一家人一样一起吃饭……就像以前那样，Aiden……

source: So, we did… and then Dad’s smile finally came back.
translation: 所以，我们照做了……然后爸爸脸上的笑容终于回来了。

source: And when it finally happened… I thought I was going to be fine…
translation: 而那一刻终于到来时……我以为自己会没事……

source: But I wasn’t.
translation: 但我没有。

source: For a long time, I was in a really dark place, where everything felt meaningless…
translation: 很长一段时间里，我都陷在一片黑暗之中，觉得一切毫无意义……

source: I started hating myself for letting Dad go… And for being the reason he had to suffer his whole life…
translation: 我开始憎恨自己，因为我让爸爸离开了……也因为是我让他一生都承受着痛苦……

source: The only thing I could think about was that everything happened because of how useless I was, and how I had no place in the world…
translation: 我唯一能想到的，就是这一切都是因为我太没用，而我在这个世界上也无处容身……

source: For a while, I did the exact thing my dad feared… I wasted away.
translation: 有一段时间，我做了爸爸最害怕我做的事……我逐渐消沉下去。

source: But then I remembered…
translation: 但后来，我想起了……

source: The promise we made to each other.
translation: 我们彼此许下的承诺。

source: When I thought I had lost everything, it was the one thing that gave me hope.
translation: 当我以为自己失去了一切时，唯有它给了我希望。

source: I promised you that I’d make something out of myself, and that was what Dad would’ve wanted for me too…
translation: 我答应过你，我会做出一番成绩，而那也是爸爸希望我做到的……

source: So I started picking myself back up.
translation: 所以，我开始重新振作起来。

source: I decided that I’d do whatever it took to be the best version of myself by the time we met again.
translation: 我决定，无论付出什么代价，都要在我们再次见面时成为最好的自己。

source: Now that I’m here and I have you, it’s everything I could have ever asked for…
translation: 如今我回来了，也拥有了你，这就是我曾奢求的一切……

source: And that’s why this time… I’m finally going to fight for what makes me truly happy.
translation: 所以这一次……我终于要为真正能让我幸福的事而奋斗。

source: And that’s to be with you, Yoshi.
translation: 那就是和你在一起，Yoshi。

source: I finally see now…
translation: 我终于明白了……

source: I hope you can forgive me for not understanding…
translation: 希望你能原谅我没能理解你……

source: And for not being there when you needed me the most…
translation: 也原谅我在你最需要我的时候没能陪在你身边……

source: I can’t let myself focus on what I couldn’t do for you then…
translation: 我不能让自己一直纠结于当时没能为你做些什么……

source: You’re here now and there’s still so much I can do.
translation: 你现在就在这里，而我还能为你做很多事。

source: I won’t ever risk letting us be apart again…
translation: 我绝不会再冒险让我们分开……

source: Because I want you to know, that your happiness is all I’ve ever wanted too.
translation: 因为我想让你知道，你的幸福也是我一直以来最大的愿望。

source: And this time around, I’ll make sure to protect your smile forever.
translation: 而这一次，我一定会永远守护你的笑容。

source: {i}(This is my new oath to you…){/i}
translation: {i}（这是我对你许下的新誓言……）{/i}

source: {i}Under the shooting stars, our lips touched, with a newfound promise to each other that we’d always be together.{/i}
translation: {i}在流星划过的夜空下，我们的双唇相触，并彼此许下了永远相伴的新承诺。{/i}
